source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 1986 official U.S. Senate canvass
source_notes: 1986 regular Arizona U.S. Senate election. County cells and statewide totals transcribed from page 1 of the official canvass issued by the Arizona Secretary of State; every candidate's 15 county cells sum to the printed statewide TOTAL. Cells were read from the printed page images. Named write-ins are included. The canvass PDF was supplied by the project maintainer from the Secretary of State and is retained under data/raw/us-senate/pdfs with its SHA-256 recorded in the snapshots.

additional_sources.title: Clerk of the U.S. House — Statistics of the Congressional Election of 1986 (Arizona U.S. Senate; cross-check)
additional_sources.notes: Statewide candidate totals (Corrected to May 29, 1987) agree with the Secretary of State canvass; the Clerk publication carries no county breakdown.
